_comment: Per-language peak RSS baseline consumed by .github/workflows/memory-regression.yml via scripts/check_memory_regression.py. Each entry is the peak_memory_mb value reported by a single-language scripts/benchmark.py run on the bundled test/models/multilingual-test-medium.onnx model on the ubuntu-24.04 CI runner (median of 6 runs, 2026-10; each language varied by at most 0.5 MB across them). threshold_pct is the +regression tolerance vs baseline; growth beyond it, a missing result or a null baseline fails the job. After an intended change, run the script with --update-baseline on the CI results (artifact memory-regression-*) and commit the JSON in the same PR.
